zh.title: 版本中心首个候选版本
zh.summary: 建立统一的软件版本、更新日志与开发者信息展示能力。
highlights: 新增“关于系统”页面，集中展示软件版本、版本状态和发布日期
新增中英文版本更新日志，并支持查看历史版本
开发者、厂商、版权、支持与许可信息纳入品牌配置
fixes: 统一后端、前端构建和健康检查使用的产品版本来源
明确区分软件版本与品牌配置版本、流程版本和报表版本
known_limits: 本候选版本暂不记录用户更新日志阅读状态
IDC 部署历史和镜像摘要仍由现有发布流程管理

en.title: First release-center candidate
en.summary: Introduces a unified software version, release notes, and developer information experience.
highlights: Adds an About page for the product version, release status, and release date
Adds bilingual release notes with release history
Moves developer, vendor, copyright, support, and license information into branding configuration
fixes: Uses one product-version source for the backend, frontend build, and health endpoint
Separates the software version from branding, workflow, and report versions
known_limits: This candidate does not yet store per-user release-note acknowledgements
IDC deployment history and image digests remain governed by the existing release workflow
